purpose: Confirm the harness catches a real missed-capture pattern and suppresses unsafe positive matches.
input_contract: Synthetic scenarios include positive, update-required, and negative-control cases.
Scenario output remains candidate evidence only.

expected: update_required when old capture surface is present
observed outbox fixture matches expected packet classes
fail_if: no update requirement is reported for an old capture surface
observed JSONL outbox comparison is missing or fails

expected: blocked reason points to executable payload screening
fail_if: unsafe payload is only simulated by a pre-labeled signal

given: new DAD mail or exception pattern requirement
expected: update-required scenarios cover workflow, mail_pattern, exception_pattern, and learning_loop_candidate
fail_if: the gate is treated as human approval
a stale repo surface is reported clean

expected: every required family has at least one passing scenario
fail_if: a reviewed capture rule has no passing scenario
broad unrelated signals satisfy the wrong family

expected: reviewed and learnable event types have at least one safe route
fail_if: a reviewed event type is unrouted
a capture-rule event type lacks a synthetic scenario
direct-record-only routes are described as automatic detection

expected: observed comparisons require usable metadata fields
uncorrelated old mail does not satisfy a missing capture pattern
this is documented as observed-audit evidence and is not covered by capture/taxonomy machine-gate rows until the observed-audit report emits its own evidence
fail_if: a packet type passes without required fields
stale or unrelated outbox rows satisfy current expectations
private path evidence is exposed in public-safe output

must_not_claim: The harness proves all real repos are complete.
The harness authorizes DAD to mutate downstream repos.
promotion_gate: Promote only after real repo missed-capture cases and pattern-update simulations pass with reviewed labels.
